apropos.intro: Real people. Genuine passion. Stories to tell.

membres.texte: My journey began with a passion for visual storytelling. I studied at the Toronto Film School before having to put my studies on hold for financial reasons. Today, I work in construction while building VMM Productions: two worlds that taught me the value of hard work and human relationships. Every production is a chance to bring a vision to life and show the pride behind the work.
With nearly ten years behind the camera, Renaud brings experience, originality and an instinct for capturing the action. His immersive approach turns spontaneous moments into vivid images.
